Xbox Emulator

 Running the Xbox Series X S library on PC. A continuation of drycheetah84/TomBox. 

The runtime reimplements the console's platform layer (Xbox-flavoured Direct3D 12, precompiled RDNA2 shaders, unified-memory textures, system libraries) so dumped, already-decrypted Xbox Series X S builds run as normal Windows processes. It is not tied to any single title. This repo tracks our continuation — new titles brought up, platform calls extended, shader stages unlocked.

Uses legally obtained, already-decrypted dumps. The runtime does no key extraction or package decryption.

 Source code: the emulator's Rust workspace is in this repo: crates/ , tools/ and Cargo.toml . It contains no game files, binaries or build output.

 Contributing: pull requests are welcome, especially console library functions still marked missing in the library map. See CONTRIBUTING.md. Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

 Status

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 One square per item. The first four sections use upstream's definitions so the numbers stay comparable: green = done, amber = partial (a stub, a forwarder, or not verified to work), grey = not done — imported system functions of the Fortnite EXE, Direct3D 12.x interface methods, RDNA2 shader instructions the decoder knows, and the eight shader stages (mesh and amplification still grey). The fifth section is ours and covers Xbox console libraries only: the exports of the console OS DLLs (EmbeddedXvd of every analysed title, union, so the newest console OS sets the surface) that no same-named DLL in a PC's C:\Windows\System32 exports, so console-only DLLs (d3d12 xs, xg xs, xmem, AcpHal, chad, xapu, xcrdapi, the legacy variants, ...) count in full and modified PC DLLs (kernel32, advapi32, mfplat, ...) only for their console-only exports, plus the GDK wrappers the emulator redirects; plain Windows DLLs (ntdll, msvcrt, ucrtbase, combase, ...) are not shown. Coloured implemented / forwarded / stub / missing; lighter squares are functions an analysed title imports. Per-title import coverage likewise counts only imports from console libraries. Generated by tools/progress/gen.py ; per-function tables in docs/LIBRARY MAP.md , headline numbers in tools/progress/summary.json . 

 Milestones

Counted live by tools/progress/gen.py ; full table with evidence in docs/MILESTONES.md.

 Milestone State 
 --- --- 
 All imported system functions covered (671/671) done 
 Full title shader sweep translated (105,506/105,506) done 
 All Direct3D 12.x methods covered in progress (map) 
 All RDNA2 instructions verified in progress (map) 
 All shader stages (Mesh, Amplification) in progress (map) 
 All Xbox console libraries covered in progress (map) 
 Fortnite boots, first frames, login, hotfix, mode select, BR lobby done (7 run milestones) 
 3D scene correct not reached 
 Keyboard / controller input not reached 
 Audio not reached 
 Gameplay not reached 
 A second title running not reached 

 Tested titles

 Title Build Result 
 --- --- --- 
 Fortnite (Chapter 2 Season 4) 2.0.1461.7919 Boots, logs in to a private server, reaches the lobby. 2D interface correct. 3D scene lit but the character material is wrong and bloom shows artifacts. No audio. Not playable. On this machine (2026-11-21): boots, first frames, window on the primary monitor, login complete, hotfix success, game-mode select, Battle Royale lobby ( UI.State.Athena.Frontend ). 
 XDefiant dump examined Not run. Imports and console OS (10.0.22000) mapped in docs/LIBRARY MAP.md; new modules include XCurl, Bink2Scarlett, chad (XDsp ), xapu (XApu ). 
 Grand Theft Auto VI 1.0.2.1 Not run (dump has no executable). Shader package examined: 26,503 shaders, plain compressed Xbox shader containers. Of a 4,000-shader sample all disassemble cleanly; ⅓ of vertex shaders translate. Blockers: mesh shaders, shaders without root signatures. 

 Our local state

- docs/DEVELOPMENT LOG.md — chronological log
- docs/BLOCKERS.md — standing walls
- docs/LIBRARY MAP.md — per-library, per-function status (generated)
- docs/LIBRARY DISCOVERY.md — what the dumps contain

 Credit

Upstream: drycheetah84/TomBox (base commit 7e8064f ). The map and badges here are generated in this repo by tools/progress/gen.py , which keeps upstream's metric definitions and style for the first four sections.
